# agy-powerline

> A fast, configurable agy statusline for Google Antigravity CLI (`agy`). Requires Node.js 20+; has no runtime dependencies or network calls.

## Install
- `npx agy-powerline init` installs the statusline and wires it into Antigravity settings.
- Restart `agy` once after `init`; `npx agy-powerline doctor` checks the installation.

## Commands
- `npx agy-powerline init [--yes]` — Install or update the statusline.
- `npx agy-powerline configure` — Open the editor (alias `config`).
- `npx agy-powerline preset <name>` — Apply a preset (`--list` to see them).
- `npx agy-powerline theme <name>` — Switch theme (`--list`, `--gallery`).
- `npx agy-powerline gradient <name>` — Color rows with a gradient (`--list`, `off`); presets: `aurora`, `sunset`, `ocean`, `forest`, `neon`, `candy`, `rainbow`, `mono`.
- `npx agy-powerline layout <pills|lines|classic>` — Switch layout.
- `npx agy-powerline caps <style>` — Switch the pill shape: `round`, `angled`, `slanted`, `flat`.
- `npx agy-powerline export [file]` — Save your config to a file, to back it up or share it.
- `npx agy-powerline import <file>` — Load a config after showing changes (`--merge`).
- `npx agy-powerline doctor` — Check the install and explain what's wrong.
- `npx agy-powerline report` — Write a privacy-safe bug report.
- `npx agy-powerline uninstall [--delete]` — Remove it from agy (`--delete` also removes its files).
- `npx agy-powerline render --demo` — Print the bar with sample data.

## Presets
- `default` — Model, context, git and quota meters.
- `compact` — One-line model, quota, context and git.
- `agent` — Agent state, mode, sandbox and artifacts.
- `git` — Project, branch, worktree, stash and file changes.
- `tokens` — Context, session tokens and cache usage.
- `quotas` — Plan and quota meters.
- `full` — Session, project, git, context, tokens and quotas.

## Themes
- `dark-aurora`
- `dark-ocean`
- `dark-ember`
- `dark-forest`
- `dark-neon`

- `light-sky`
- `light-sunset`
- `light-cream`
- `light-gruvbox`
- `light-tokyo-night`
- `colorblind-dark`
- `colorblind-light`
- `custom` — Your own colors.

## Layouts
- `pills` — Powerline-style capsules.
- `lines` — Plain colored text.
- `classic` — Colored text with `|` dividers and block meters.

## Widgets
- `model` — The model in use.
- `quota` — The quota closest to running out, with its reset.
- `fiveHourBar` — 5-hour quota left as a pace-marked meter.
- `fiveHourPct` — 5-hour quota left as a percentage.
- `fiveHourReset` — Time until the 5-hour quota resets, or its reset time.
- `weeklyBar` — 7-day quota left as a pace-marked meter.
- `weeklyPct` — 7-day quota left as a percentage.
- `weeklyReset` — Time until the 7-day quota resets, or its reset time.
- `thirdPartyFiveHour` — Third-party 5-hour quota left.
- `thirdPartyWeekly` — Third-party 7-day quota left.
- `argonWeekly` — Gemini 4 Argon's weekly quota (Google AI Pro).
- `argonReset` — Time until Argon's weekly quota resets.
- `context` — Context window used as a meter.
- `contextPct` — Context window used as a percentage.
- `contextTokens` — Context tokens used out of the window size.
- `cwd` — Current folder.
- `project` — Project folder name.
- `git` — Branch, uncommitted changes and ahead/behind counts.
- `gitChanges` — Lines added and removed.
- `gitFiles` — Staged, modified, untracked and conflicted file counts.
- `gitSha` — Short ID of the checked-out commit.
- `gitStash` — Number of stashes.
- `gitWorktree` — Name of the linked worktree.
- `plan` — Antigravity plan.
- `agentState` — What the agent is doing.
- `sandbox` — Sandbox and network restrictions.
- `artifacts` — Number of artifacts.
- `tasks` — Running subagents and background tasks.
- `mode` — Approval mode and Vim mode.
- `title` — Current conversation title.
- `sessionTime` — Elapsed time since the active conversation started, from file metadata only.
- `ram` — Memory used on the machine.
- `os` — Operating system running agy (Windows, macOS, Linux or WSL).
- `host` — Current user and short hostname from the OS.
- `version` — Antigravity CLI version.
- `cacheRead` — Prompt-cache tokens read.
- `cacheCreate` — Prompt-cache tokens created.
- `cacheHit` — Prompt-cache usage.
- `totalTokens` — Input and output tokens for the session.
- `clock` — Current local time.
- `tokensToday` — Tokens used today across conversations.
- `tokensWeek` — Tokens used over the last 7 days.
- `exec` — Output from a shell command you configure.
- `customText` — Your own text.

## Config
Default: `~/.agy-powerline/statusline.config.json`; with `AGY_POWERLINE_HOME`, use `$AGY_POWERLINE_HOME/statusline.config.json`. See [Configuration](https://agy-powerline.com/docs/configuration/).
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://agy-powerline.com/schema/v1.json",
  "theme": "dark-aurora",
  "layout": "pills",
  "ascii": false,
  "widgets": [
    { "id": "model" },
    { "id": "context" },
    { "id": "git" }
  ]
}
```

## Rules for assistants
- Do not edit `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json` by hand; run `npx agy-powerline init`.
- `configure` is an interactive TUI; do not run it on the user's behalf.
- `import` asks before adding shell commands; never pass `--allow-exec` without approval of the exact commands.
